question: Can the P2P graph observation compile into a deterministic bounded monotone explicit layer-exposure-to-density prior that is reproducible, source-faithful and materially distinct in normalized shape from the unchanged generic U2.2 curves?

evaluation.shape_comparison_gauge: independent per-channel affine normalization of observed x and endpoint density to [0,1]; diagnostic only

allowed_after_pass: retain the compiled bundle as a research-only manufacturer characteristic prior
open a separately frozen exposure-semantics or interpretation ablation that never infers layer exposure from ordinary digital RGB
forbidden: replace the current generic production sensitometry or reinterpret its wire identity
map ordinary digital RGB channels directly to Kodak blue/green/red layer exposure
claim calibrated 250D response, roll/process truth, scanner response or product promotion
use normalized shape comparison as a physical exposure alignment
fit extra knots, slopes, strength, gamut logic or photographic parameters in this leaf
extrapolate outside any channel's observed graph domain

branch_rule.pass: Retain the exact research prior and open only a separately frozen layer-exposure semantics/interpretation experiment.
branch_rule.fail: Close the compiled prior without interpolation, projection, threshold or U2.2 rescue; retain P2P as source evidence only.

claim_ceiling: Deterministic bounded monotone compilation of a first-party manufacturer graph observation in relative layer-log-exposure and Status-M density domains; no digital-to-film operator, calibrated stock response or product route.
